description: This file defines a PHP class 'KpiMenuConfigurator' that implements the 'MenuConfigurator' interface. It resides in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Performance\Menu' and is responsible for configuring the menu related to KPI (Key Performance Indicators) in the OrangeHRM performance module. The class uses a trait for module screen helpers and overrides the screen to 'searchKpi' within a 'configure' method.

classes.name: KpiMenuConfigurator
classes.description: A class implementing menu configuration for KPI section in the performance module, overriding the screen to 'searchKpi'.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Overrides the screen to 'searchKpi' for the current module, implementing the MenuConfigurator interface.
